phase: Phase 2 - authenticated student profile and curriculum catalogue (pre-pilot)
notes: Supabase project learning-radar is active in Tokyo (ap-northeast-1).
Nine database migrations have been applied to the remote project.
3,349 Ministry of Education school records and 238 active 115 AY NAER-approved textbook options have been seeded.
All 13 public tables have RLS enabled. anon has no public table or sequence grants; authenticated has minimum application grants, with RLS enforcing row ownership.
Default privileges for future public tables, sequences and functions created by postgres have been tightened.
Email/password signup and login are implemented without a verification-email workflow. Hosted Supabase Dashboard still requires Confirm Email to be disabled manually.
When Confirm Email is disabled, signup returns a session; server action redirects directly to /dashboard. If no session is returned, the app reports that the hosted setting is still enabled.
Node.js 26.x is used by Vercel and GitHub Actions; CI has passed on the current implementation before this latest auth adjustment, and the latest commit triggers a new run.
Vercel Production domain is https://learning-radar-wheat.vercel.app; Preview deployments remain SSO protected.
LINE Login is not implemented; can be added later with a LINE Login channel ID, channel secret and callback URL configuration.
Disabling email confirmation allows unverified email strings to register. A user may not be able to recover a forgotten password via email if they cannot access that mailbox.
Textbook unit content and knowledge points are not yet imported; AI question generation and assessment analysis are not yet implemented.

School-specific textbook adoption and evidence tables are deployed; 30 grade/subject/semester records have been imported for one junior-high school from its official 115 AY notice; the adoption evidence table stores the official source and independent third-party English-version cross-check.

School-reported publisher labels are preserved separately from NAER-approved catalog publishers; the official Anping English label Hanlin is mapped to the approved Joy publisher based on a third-party 115 English comparison.
The textbook UI links directly to OneClass and AIMii (EduBaania) as secondary cross-check sources; school-year official announcements remain the primary authority.
School adoption coverage is not nationwide yet; when a school/subject has no verified source match, the UI shows no inferred publisher rather than inventing one.
Vercel Serverless Function region has been moved from iad1 to hnd1 (Tokyo) to colocate the app server with the Supabase database.
Minors' privacy notice and guardian consent workflow must be completed before public launch.
